title: Senior DevOps Engineer
summary: Own the Kubernetes platform behind a multi-region cloud product.
description: Nimbus Grid runs workloads across three regions for customers who cannot tolerate downtime. You will own the platform layer end to end: cluster lifecycle, deployment pipelines, and the observability stack the whole engineering org depends on.
responsibilities: Operate and scale production Kubernetes clusters across AWS regions
Own Terraform modules used by every product team
Reduce deployment lead time through CI/CD pipeline work
Lead incident response and drive blameless postmortems
requirements: 5+ years in DevOps, SRE or platform engineering
Deep hands-on Kubernetes in production, not just managed defaults

title: Backend Engineer (Go)
summary: Build the settlement services that move money for fintech customers.
description: SafeLedger processes settlement flows for regulated fintech clients. Correctness matters more than throughput here: every service is built around idempotency, auditability, and a hard requirement that money is never double-counted.
responsibilities: Design and ship Go services handling payment settlement
Model event flows on Kafka with exactly-once semantics
Write the tests that keep a financial ledger honest
Partner with compliance on audit requirements
requirements: Production Go or a strong case for switching to it
Relational modelling and PostgreSQL at scale

title: מפתח/ת Frontend
summary: בניית ממשקי ניתוח נתונים כבדים ב-React ו-TypeScript.
description: ב-PulseMetric אנחנו בונים כלי אנליטיקה שמציגים מיליוני נקודות נתונים בזמן אמת. התפקיד דורש הבנה עמוקה בביצועים בדפדפן, ולא רק היכרות עם ספריות UI.
responsibilities: פיתוח ממשקי משתמש מורכבים ב-React ו-TypeScript
אופטימיזציה של ביצועי רינדור בטבלאות וגרפים גדולים
עבודה צמודה עם צוות העיצוב על מערכת קומפוננטות משותפת
שיפור נגישות המוצר לרמת AA
requirements: שלוש שנות ניסיון ומעלה בפיתוח Frontend

title: Platform Engineer
summary: Developer-experience work at a small, opinionated tooling company.
description: KernelWorks is twenty-two people building developer tooling. The platform team is three of them. You will spend your time removing friction for other engineers rather than babysitting infrastructure.
responsibilities: Own the internal developer platform and its golden paths
Cut CI times and keep the build pipeline fast
Automate environment provisioning end to end
Set the standards other teams build against
requirements: 4+ years platform, DevOps or infrastructure engineering
CI/CD design, not just pipeline maintenance

title: Full Stack Engineer
summary: First engineering hire on a clinical scheduling product.
description: OrbitCare builds scheduling software used by clinics. This is a broad role with real ownership early: you will touch the React client, the Node services behind it, and the data model underneath.
responsibilities: Ship features across the React client and Node API
Work directly with clinicians to shape requirements
Keep patient data handling correct and auditable
Grow the test suite alongside the product
requirements: 1-2 years of professional experience or a strong portfolio
JavaScript or TypeScript across client and server
Willingness to work onsite in Haifa

title: Product Manager, Growth
summary: Own activation and retention for a logistics marketplace.
description: Driftly connects carriers with shippers. Growth here is not a funnel-tuning exercise: supply and demand have to move together, and the product decisions that work on one side often break the other.
responsibilities: Own the activation and retention roadmap end to end
Run experiments with clear hypotheses and honest readouts
Translate qualitative research into shipped product changes
Align engineering, design and ops around a single set of metrics
requirements: 4+ years in product management, at least two on growth
Fluency with experiment design and analytics tooling
Track record shipping in a marketplace or two-sided product

title: מנהל/ת מוצר
summary: ניהול מוצר גיוס המשמש מאות מנהלי משאבי אנוש.
description: ב-Tandem HQ אנחנו בונים מערכת גיוס שמשמשת צוותי HR בארגונים בינוניים. אנחנו מחפשים מנהל/ת מוצר שיודע/ת לעבוד מול משתמשים אמיתיים ולא רק מול דשבורדים.
responsibilities: הובלת מפת הדרכים של מודול הגיוס
ראיונות משתמשים שוטפים והפיכתם לדרישות מוצר
עבודה יומיומית מול צוותי פיתוח ועיצוב
הגדרת מדדי הצלחה ומעקב אחריהם
requirements: ניסיון בעבודה עם צוותי פיתוח בשיטות אג׳יליות

title: Senior Frontend Engineer
summary: Design-system and performance work on an AI platform console.
description: Verdant AI is building the console engineers use to run model pipelines. The surface is dense, stateful and heavily keyboard-driven, so component architecture and accessibility are first-order concerns rather than polish.
responsibilities: Own the shared component library and its accessibility posture
Drive rendering performance on data-dense screens
Define frontend architecture standards across teams
Mentor mid-level engineers through code review
requirements: 5+ years frontend, with real design-system ownership
Demonstrated accessibility work to WCAG AA

title: Frontend Engineer, Design System
summary: Own the component library used by every product team.
description: The design system is the surface every other team builds on. You will own its components, its documentation and its accessibility posture, working directly with two designers.
responsibilities: Build and maintain shared React components
Keep the library accessible to WCAG AA
Write the documentation engineers actually read
Review usage across product teams

title: Senior Backend Engineer
summary: Query engine work on a real-time analytics product.
description: PulseMetric ingests millions of events an hour and has to answer arbitrary queries over them in under a second. This role sits on the query path.
responsibilities: Design and optimise the query execution path
Own data modelling for time-series workloads
Profile and remove performance bottlenecks
Mentor mid-level engineers

title: מהנדס/ת DevOps
summary: תשתיות ענן למערכת לוגיסטיקה בזמן אמת.
description: ב-Driftly אנחנו מפעילים מערכת שמחברת מובילים ומשלחים בזמן אמת. התשתית צריכה להיות זמינה תמיד, וזה בדיוק התפקיד.
responsibilities: תחזוקה ושדרוג של קלאסטרים ב-Kubernetes
בניית פייפליינים ל-CI/CD
ניטור והתראות על מערכות הפרודקשן
אוטומציה של תהליכי פריסה

title: Junior Frontend Developer
summary: First frontend role on a regulated fintech product.
description: You will join a team of four building the dashboards compliance officers use every day. Expect a lot of code review and a lot of learning.
responsibilities: Build UI features in React and TypeScript
Fix bugs reported by internal users
Write component tests
Learn the domain from the people who know it
requirements: Some professional experience or a strong portfolio

title: Full Stack Engineer
summary: Developer tooling, end to end, at a small company.
description: Twenty-two people, one product, no handoffs. You will design a feature, build the API, build the UI and ship it yourself.
responsibilities: Ship features across Node services and a React client
Own features from spec to production
Support the users, who are engineers like you
Keep the test suite meaningful
requirements: Good written communication for a remote team

title: מנהל/ת מוצר קליני
summary: ניהול מוצר מול צוותים רפואיים במרפאות.
description: המוצר משמש מרפאות אמיתיות עם מטופלים אמיתיים. תצטרכו לשבת מול רופאים ואחיות, להבין את העבודה שלהם, ולתרגם אותה למוצר.
responsibilities: הובלת מפת הדרכים של המוצר הקליני
עבודה שוטפת מול צוותים רפואיים
הגדרת דרישות מוצר ומדדי הצלחה
ניהול מחזור חיים של פיצ׳רים מקצה לקצה
requirements: ארבע שנות ניסיון ומעלה בניהול מוצר
יכולת לתרגם צרכים מורכבים לדרישות ברורות

title: Site Reliability Engineer
summary: Set the reliability bar for a multi-region platform.
description: This is a leadership role without direct reports. You will define SLOs, run the incident process, and decide where reliability work goes next.
responsibilities: Define and own service level objectives
Lead the incident and postmortem process
Drive reliability work across product teams
Build the observability stack others depend on
requirements: 7+ years in SRE or platform engineering

title: Frontend Developer (Part Time)
summary: Part-time React work on an HR platform.
description: Three days a week, fully remote. The work is steady feature development on an established React codebase rather than greenfield.
responsibilities: Build features in an existing React application
Improve accessibility across the product
Work asynchronously with a small team

title: Data Engineer
summary: Build the pipelines feeding a model platform.
description: Every model on the platform is only as good as the data reaching it. You will own the pipelines, the quality checks and the contracts between teams.
responsibilities: Design and operate batch and streaming pipelines
Own data quality checks and alerting
Define schema contracts with consuming teams
Keep pipeline costs under control
requirements: Streaming experience with Kafka or similar

title: מפתח/ת Full Stack
summary: פיתוח מקצה לקצה במוצר אנליטיקה.
description: התפקיד נוגע בכל השכבות: ממשק המשתמש, שכבת ה-API, והמודל שמאחוריהם. אנחנו מחפשים מישהו/י שנוח לו לנוע בין כולן.
responsibilities: פיתוח פיצ׳רים מקצה לקצה ב-React ו-Node
תכנון סכמות נתונים ושאילתות
שיפור ביצועים בצד השרת ובצד הלקוח
ליווי מפתחים זוטרים

responsibilities: Design and build REST and GraphQL endpoints
Keep the API contract stable and well documented
Improve error handling and observability

Fix bugs in the admin interface
Write tests for what you ship

responsibilities: Set architectural direction across backend teams
Own the hardest correctness and consistency decisions
Partner with compliance and security
Grow senior engineers into architects

title: Frontend Engineer

responsibilities: Rebuild the scheduling UI in React

responsibilities: Automate repetitive infrastructure tasks
Help maintain CI pipelines

responsibilities: הובלת אסטרטגיית המוצר לפלטפורמת התשתיות
עבודה צמודה עם צוותי הנדסה
תעדוף מול צרכים מתחרים של לקוחות פנימיים
הגדרת מדדים והצגתם להנהלה

ניסיון במוצרי תשתית או מוצרים למפתחים
רקע טכני שמאפשר שיחה עם מהנדסים

title: Enterprise Account Executive
summary: Close six-figure deals with banks and insurers across EMEA.
description: SafeLedger sells compliance infrastructure to regulated finance. Deals are long, technical and committee-driven. You will own named enterprise accounts end to end, from first outbound touch to signed contract, with a solutions engineer alongside you. Base plus uncapped commission, OTE roughly double base.
responsibilities: Own the full sales cycle for named enterprise accounts
Build pipeline through outbound prospecting, not just inbound leads
Run commercial and contract negotiation alongside legal
Forecast accurately and keep the CRM current
requirements: 5+ years closing B2B SaaS deals, enterprise segment
Track record of quota attainment you can talk through
Comfortable selling to compliance and risk stakeholders
niceToHave: MEDDIC or Command of the Message

title: נציג/ת פיתוח עסקי (SDR)
summary: בניית פייפליין לצוות המכירות דרך פנייה יזומה.
description: Driftly מוכרת תוכנה לניהול צי רכב לחברות לוגיסטיקה. התפקיד הוא הכניסה לעולם המכירות: פנייה יזומה, סינון לידים והעברת פגישות איכותיות לסוכני השטח. יש תוכנית הכשרה מסודרת ומסלול קידום ברור ל-AE תוך שנה עד שנתיים.
responsibilities: פנייה יזומה בטלפון ובאימייל ליעדים מוגדרים
סינון לידים נכנסים לפי קריטריונים מוסכמים
קביעת פגישות עבור סוכני השטח
תיעוד מלא ומדויק ב-CRM
requirements: שנה ניסיון בפנייה יזומה או שירות לקוחות

title: Account Manager, Mid-Market
summary: Grow and retain a book of 40 mid-market accounts.
description: Tandem HQ sells HR software to companies between 100 and 1000 people. This role is retention and expansion rather than new logos: quarterly business reviews, renewal negotiation, and finding the upsell before the customer asks.
responsibilities: Own renewals and expansion across a named book of accounts
Run quarterly business reviews with customer stakeholders
Spot churn risk early and act on it
Forecast renewal revenue each quarter

Coach AEs through live deals rather than reviewing them after
Hire and onboard as the team grows
Design territory and account allocation

Personal track record closing B2B SaaS before managing
Rigour about pipeline hygiene and forecast accuracy

responsibilities: Run product demos for engineering leaders
Convert self-serve accounts into team contracts
Feed product gaps back to engineering with evidence
Keep pipeline and forecast honest in the CRM
requirements: Able to hold a credible conversation with engineers
Comfortable with a short, high-volume cycle
niceToHave: Technical enough to run your own demo

responsibilities: ניהול מחזור מכירה מלא מול מוסדות רפואיים
מענה למכרזים ותיאום מול גורמי רגולציה
בניית קשרים ארוכי טווח עם בעלי עניין
תחזית מכירות רבעונית מדויקת
requirements: ניסיון מול המגזר הציבורי או הרפואי

title: Sales Development Representative
summary: Part-time outbound role, suited to students.
description: Verdant AI needs consistent top-of-funnel activity without a full-time hire. Four days a week, mornings, with a defined script and a target list. Genuine progression to full-time for anyone who hits target twice running.
responsibilities: Cold email and cold calling against a defined target list
Qualify responses and book meetings
Log every touch in HubSpot
